title: Bug: admin_book_change_category_ перехватывается start_change_book
description: Из-за того что F.data.startswith('admin_book_change_') зарегистрирован раньше чем F.data.startswith('admin_book_change_category_'), клик по 'Изменить категорию' уводит обратно в меню изменения книги. Нужно переместить admin_book_change_category_/admin_book_set_category_/process_new_category_admin в файл до start_change_book.
close_reason: Перенёс admin_book_change_category_/admin_book_set_category_/process_new_category_admin выше start_change_book (admin_book_change_) — теперь клик по 'Изменить категорию' открывает меню выбора категории, а не возвращает в меню изменения книги.

title: Fix admin panel: edit books, delete books, support button
description: In the Telegram bot admin panel: 'edit book' (all sub-actions), 'delete book' buttons don't work, and the 'Support' button in the start menu doesn't deliver messages to admins. Investigate callback/state registration in handlers/admin_books.py, handlers/user.py, and main.py router order. Fix root causes; verify with running bot if possible.
close_reason: Fixed in handlers/admin_books.py (L665, L925) and handlers/user.py (L116, L174). Filter conflicts in aiogram 3 first-match dispatch were swallowing the field-editor and delete-confirm callbacks. Support forwarding moved to the top of universal_text_handler and the support callback now clears FSM state.

title: Per-field edit on confirmation screen
description: Replace the single '✏️ Изменить' button on the confirmation screen with a per-field menu: admin_book_edit_title / _author / _price / _category / _description / _cover / _pages so the admin can jump straight to the field that's wrong.

title: Preview book card before confirm
description: In admin_books.confirm_add_book (and the prior 'Подтверждение' step), show the admin what the book card will look like in Mini App: cover thumb (if present) + title/author/category/price/short description, so they can spot typos and decide on confirm.

title: Persist support_active flag in DB so dialogs survive restart
description: settings.support_pending_users is an in-memory set; bot restart wipes it. Add is_support_active column to users table (migration in init_db), add db.set_support_active / db.is_support_active helpers, hydrate the in-memory set on startup and sync writes through.
close_reason: Added is_support_active column migration in db/__init__.py; helpers set_support_active/is_support_active/get_all_support_active_user_ids in db/users.py; main.py hydrates settings.support_pending_users from DB on startup; new set_support_mode() helper in handlers/user.py syncs cache+DB on every change.

title: Clean up book-confirm message after admin confirms add
description: In handlers/admin_books.py, confirm_add_book used callback.message.answer(...) and left the prior '📚 Подтверждение добавления книги' message (with Подтвердить/Изменить/Отмена buttons) in the chat. Expected behavior: delete that confirmation message and send a fresh result message. Fix: delete callback.message, then answer with the success/error text + '🔙 В админ-панель' button.
close_reason: Fixed in handlers/admin_books.py:confirm_add_book — delete the prior 'Подтверждение добавления книги' message (works for both text and photo+caption) and send a fresh result message with '🔙 В админ-панель' button. Added await callback.answer() so the spinner clears.

title: Fix support dialog: keep user in support mode after sending
description:
Bug: after the user sends a support message, they are immediately removed from settings.support_pending_users in universal_text_handler (handlers/user.py:183). After receiving the admin's reply, the user has to click 'Поддержка' in the start menu again to write back. 

Fix: don't discard the user from the set after the first message; let them continue the dialog until they explicitly cancel (/cancel) or start a new flow (/start).
close_reason: Fixed: keep user in support_pending_users after sending so the dialog continues until /cancel or /start. /reply_ also re-adds the user as a safety net (e.g. after bot restart). UX text updated to set the expectation that the user can keep typing.

title: 'Без категории' placeholder for uncategorised books
description: Books with empty/null category_id or no matching category show as 'Без категории' in admin listings and catalog. Add a get_category_safe(category_id) helper that returns 'Без категории' as fallback. Update admin_books, catalog and DB queries.

title: Warn on duplicate (title, author) when adding a book
description: When admin enters a title+author pair that already exists in the catalog, show a warning 'Такая книга уже есть в каталоге (ID=X). Всё равно добавить?' with [✅ Да, добавить] / [✏️ Изменить данные]. Use the existing title input path.

title: Accept media_group for page-photos upload
description: Allow admins to upload page photos as a Telegram album (media_group) in one go instead of one-by-one. Hook aiogram's media_group filter on BookAddState.waiting_for_page_photos, save all photos then show the standard 'N photos added' confirmation.

title: Consistent back navigation across all book-add steps
description: Add ⬅️ Назад on every step of the book-add flow where it's missing (currently missing on the confirmation screen and on some cover/photo sub-steps) and make sure each step's 'Назад' returns the data entered up to that point.

title: Replace print() debug/error logging with logger in handlers
description: handlers/payments.py, handlers/user.py, handlers/admin_books.py and others use print(...) for debug/error output. These get lost in production logs. Replace with the project's setup_logger() so they go through the configured handler.
close_reason: handlers/payments.py: replaced 42 print() calls with setup_logger() (debug/info/warning by severity). handlers/user.py: two remaining print() calls (web_app_data and orders error handlers) replaced with logger.warning. No more stray print() in handlers/.

title: Validate description length and page_photos count in book-add flow
description: admin_books.py accepts arbitrary-length descriptions and unbounded page_photos lists. Telegram caption limit is 1024 chars; bot text limit is 4096. Add explicit limits: description <= 3500 chars, page_photos <= 20. Reject with a clear inline error before persisting state.
close_reason: Added MAX_DESCRIPTION_LENGTH=3500 enforced in process_description with friendly inline error; MAX_PAGE_PHOTOS=20 enforced in both photo and URL page-photo handlers; MAX_PHOTO_FILE_BYTES=9MB enforced before saving a page photo, so admin gets 'Telegram Bot API принимает файлы до 10 МБ' instead of a cryptic failure.

title: Handle TelegramForbiddenError in /reply_ and other user-facing sends
description: admin_reply_to_user (handlers/user.py) calls bot.send_message(user_id, ...) which raises TelegramForbiddenError when the user has blocked the bot. Catch it specifically and tell the admin that the user is unreachable; also drop the user from support_pending_users so we don't keep retrying.
close_reason: admin_reply_to_user catches TelegramForbiddenError separately from generic Exception; on hit drops the user from support mode (via set_support_mode) and tells the admin the user blocked the bot.

title: /cancel: report what was cancelled
description: Universal /cancel currently silently clears state and removes support/broadcast flags. Make it report exactly what got cancelled (active FSM state + support dialog + broadcast draft) so the user knows what just happened.
close_reason: cancel_action now reports exactly what was cancelled: current FSM state name, support dialog, and broadcast draft. Shows 'ℹ️ Нечего отменять' if nothing was active. Uses set_support_mode for persistence.

title: Exit support mode on main-menu navigation buttons
description: Pressing Мои заказы / О магазине / Пригласить друга / В меню currently leaves the user in support mode, so the next text message still gets forwarded to admins. Discard user from support_pending_users in those callbacks (and persist via the new DB helper).
close_reason: my_orders, about, main_menu, invite_friend callbacks now call set_support_mode(user_id, False) so navigating away from support exits the dialog and the next text message is not forwarded to admins.
